import type { AgentStatus, TaskStatus } from '../types'

export type Lang = 'es' | 'en'

/** Every sentence the mod shows or says to the model, in one language. */
export type Messages = {
  // for the model: the rules it reads, the tools it calls and what they answer
  planRules: string
  denyNoPlan: string
  planToolDescription: string
  taskToolDescription: string
  goalDescription: string
  tasksDescription: string
  idDescription: string
  noteDescription: string
  emptyPlan: string
  untitled: string
  todoGoal: string
  planRegistered: (count: number, list: string) => string
  noSuchTask: (id: string, ids: string) => string
  badStatus: (status: string) => string
  denyDone: (id: string, kind: string, command: string) => string
  taskUpdated: (id: string, status: string, verification: 'with' | 'without' | 'n/a', done: number, total: number) => string

  // vocabulary
  status: Record<TaskStatus, string>
  agentStatus: Record<AgentStatus, string>

  // notes the mod writes on a task
  resumedNote: string
  interruptedNote: string
  manualDone: string
  manualBlocked: string
  manualFailed: string
  previously: (status: string) => string

  // /taskboard command
  commandDescription: string
  paneTitle: string
  closed: string
  cleared: string
  skipped: string
  paneNotShown: (reason: string) => string
  noActivePlan: string
  historyEmpty: string
  historyHeading: string

  // panel
  boardTitle: string
  historyTitle: string
  plansCount: (count: number) => string
  savedPlans: string
  noFinished: string
  expandAll: string
  collapse: string
  viewBoard: string
  viewHistory: string
  clear: string
  reopen: string
  historyHelp: string
  dropEntry: string
  historyDropped: (number: number, goal: string) => string
  historyNoEntry: (number: number, count: number) => string
  historyWiped: (count: number) => string
  historyUsage: string
  noticeTitle: string
  noticeBlocking: string
  noticeSuggesting: string
  skipPlan: string
  noPlanBody: string
  noPlanHint: string
  historyHint: (count: number) => string
  taskDetail: (status: string, calls: number, checks: number) => string
  start: string
  markDone: string
  block: string
  fail: string
  activeAgents: (count: number) => string
  resumedBanner: string
  looseAgents: (names: string) => string
  helpTask: string
  helpBoard: string
  rootLabel: string
  branchLabel: string
  noBranch: string
  // tokens and cost
  tokensLine: (input: string, output: string, cache: string, agents: string, cost: string) => string
  totalLine: (tokens: string, cost: string) => string
  statsTitle: (goal: string) => string
  statsNoPlan: string
  statsRow: (id: string, title: string, tokens: string, detail: string, cost: string) => string
  statsUntracked: (tokens: string) => string
  statsTotal: (tokens: string, cost: string) => string
  statsOverhead: (rules: string, tools: string, total: string) => string
}

const TABLE: Record<Lang, Messages> = { es, en }

export function messages(lang: Lang): Messages {
  return TABLE[lang]
}

/** The system's locale as the runtime reports it, or an empty string when it does not. */
export function systemLocale(): string {
  try {
    return Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().locale
  } catch {
    return ''
  }
}

/** `es`, `en`, or `auto` (the system locale: Spanish for es-*, English otherwise). */
export function resolveLang(option: unknown, locale: string): Lang {
  if (option === 'es' || option === 'en') return option

  return locale.toLowerCase().startsWith('es') ? 'es' : 'en'
}

{
  "name": "agent-taskboard",
  "version": "0.7.0",
  "description": "A live task board for Claude Code: plans before building and shows every task, its status, time, subagents and checks in a side panel. Progress survives sessions.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Yohan Garcia",
    "url": "https://github.com/YohanGarcia"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/YohanGarcia/agent-taskboard",
  "repository": "https://github.com/YohanGarcia/agent-taskboard",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "claude-code-mod",
    "claude-code-plugin",
    "tasks",
    "planning",
    "dashboard",
    "subagents",
    "productivity"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "openOnStart": {
      "title": "Abrir al iniciar / Open on start",
      "description": "Abrir el panel del tablero al iniciar la sesión / Open the board panel when the session starts",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": true
    },
    "minPromptChars": {
      "title": "Umbral de complejidad / Complexity threshold",
      "description": "Longitud mínima (caracteres) de una solicitud para considerarla compleja; también la detectan varias acciones o listas / Minimum length (characters) for a request to count as complex; several actions or lists also trigger it",
      "type": "number",
      "default": 240
    },
    "mode": {
      "title": "Modo / Mode",
      "description": "full: herramientas plan/task, reglas en el prompt y guard; light: sin herramientas ni reglas, solo refleja el plan nativo y TodoWrite (sin sobrecosto de tokens) / full: plan/task tools, prompt rules and guard; light: no tools or rules, only mirrors the native plan and TodoWrite (no token overhead)",
      "type": "string",
      "options": [
        "full",
        "light"
      ],
      "default": "full"
    },
    "planMode": {
      "title": "Modo del plan / Plan mode",
      "description": "block: bloquea Edit/Write hasta que haya plan; warn: solo avisa en el panel; off: no vigila / block: Edit/Write wait for a plan; warn: only a notice in the panel; off: no guard",
      "type": "string",
      "options": [
        "block",
        "warn",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "block"
    },
    "extraChecks": {
      "title": "Verificaciones extra / Extra checks",
      "description": "Comandos que cuentan como verificación, separados por coma (basta con un fragmento, p. ej. 'composer test, artisan test') / Commands that count as a check, comma-separated (a fragment is enough, e.g. 'composer test, artisan test')",
      "type": "string",
      "default": ""
    },
    "language": {
      "title": "Idioma / Language",
      "description": "auto: sigue el idioma del sistema (es o en); también es o en / auto: follows the system language (es or en); or es / en",
      "type": "string",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "es",
        "en"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    }
  }
}
